source_title: AGENTS.md Don't Scale Beyond Modest Codebases — Codified Context Paper

discovered_urls.context: Central subject of the post — the 'Codified Context' paper documenting a three-tier agent memory architecture built during real development of a 108K-line C# distributed system over 283 sessions
discovered_urls.relevance_hint: Most rigorous longitudinal production evidence for multi-file context engineering; three-tier memory model (hot constitution / domain-expert agents / cold-memory MCP retrieval) directly validates and extends our architecture; knowledge-to-code ratio of 24.2% is a concrete benchmark
